additions.description: Implements GET /password-recovery-html/{email} endpoint for superusers to get password recovery token as HTML
additions.reasoning: The specification does not mention this endpoint for retrieving password recovery tokens as HTML format.

additions.description: Implements PATCH /users/{user_id} endpoint for superusers to update any user's details
additions.reasoning: The specification focuses on user self-updates and doesn't explicitly require a superuser endpoint for updating any user.

additions.description: Implements UserUpdate model with is_active and is_superuser fields that can be modified by superusers
additions.reasoning: The specification doesn't mention the ability to modify user activation status or superuser status through API calls.

omissions.description: Does not implement email verification for password recovery via mailcatcher service (GET http://localhost:1080/messages)
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires verifying that password recovery emails were actually sent via the mailcatcher service.

omissions.description: Does not implement cascade deletion of items when a user is deleted (though the relationship is configured, the specification explicitly requires verifying item deletion when owner is deleted)
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires verifying that items are deleted when their owner is deleted, but the code doesn't explicitly test this behavior.

omissions.description: Does not return 400 with 'Not enough permissions' when a normal user tries to read another user's item (returns 403 instead)
omissions.reasoning: The specification explicitly requires returning 400 with 'Not enough permissions' for item access violations, but the code returns 403.

omissions.description: Does not validate that password recovery tokens are invalid after use
omissions.reasoning: The specification implies tokens should be single-use, but the code doesn't invalidate them after password reset.

omissions.description: Does not implement proper validation for empty string titles when creating items (allows empty string through validation but spec implies this should be invalid)
omissions.reasoning: The specification's test cases expect 422 for empty string titles, but the code's validation allows empty strings.
